summary: Accept a `<type>:<value>` shorthand (data_source_id:<id>, database_id:, page_id:, block_id:, workspace:true) for --parent in addition to raw JSON, via a shared parseParentFlag helper, and emit an actionable error instead of an opaque JSON parse error.
reason: The prior pages-object-flags-json-parse patch made --parent JSON-only, so the natural ergonomic value `--parent data_source_id:<id>` failed with `parsing --parent JSON: invalid character 'd' looking for beginning of value`. The parse ran before the --dry-run guard, so --dry-run could not even be exercised. The shorthand expands to the discriminated parent object the API requires; raw JSON still passes through unchanged.
validated_outcome: pages create --parent data_source_id:<id> --markdown '## ...' --dry-run --json now expands to {"type":"data_source_id","data_source_id":"<id>"} and reaches the dry-run path (exit 0); previously failed at the JSON parse. TestParseParentFlag covers all five shorthand forms, JSON back-compat, and three error paths.
